title: Chapter 2732: Ninth Heaven(2)
content:
Chapter 2732: Ninth Heaven(2)

The spiritual energy filling the Ninth Heaven was incredibly dense and rich, incomparably superior to that of the Eighth Heaven.

There was a reason nearly every cultivator in the lower realms dreamed of ascending higher and eventually reaching the Ninth Heaven. With such an abundance of spiritual energy, reaching the God Ascension realm would be incomparably easier.

Of course, whether one could truly reach the God Ascension realm still depended heavily on their individual talent, as an abundance of spiritual energy alone could never guarantee success.

Shortly after Yuan arrived at the Ninth Heaven, a notification popped up before him, raising his eyebrows.

<Congratulations! You have reached the Supreme Heaven and fulfilled the first requirement of Supreme Heaven’s Legacy!>

<You have acquired a Unique Quest!>

[Unique Quest: Island of Liberty]

[Description: Bring the exile ’Xiao Hua’ to the Island of Liberty and pass the trial presented to you.]

[Reward: The exile ’Xiao Hua’ and those of the same bloodline may leave the Primordial Realm and will no longer be considered exiles.]

Yuan couldn’t help but chuckle after seeing the new quest.

Although Xiao Hua and her family had already been freed from the Primordial Realm, they were still branded as exiles, and that status would remain until Yuan completed the legacy.

However, Yuan had no intention of fulfilling it. Once he dealt with the Celestial Emperor—something he knew would eventually happen—they would be free regardless.

Ding!

Suddenly, another notification appeared.

<Due to Supreme Heaven’s Legacy, Xiao Hua’s Mark of Banishment has strengthened>

’Mark of Banishment... This must be the curse that identifies someone as an exile. If it’s grown stronger, does that mean she’ll have a much harder time concealing her status as one?’ Yuan wondered inwardly.

While one might have expected Yuan to be concerned for Xiao Hua, he actually felt pity for anyone bold enough to hunt her down, especially now that she’s regained her memory and power.

Some time later, Yuan stopped lingering and went to the nearest city.

"Is there a Myriad of Techniques in this city?" Yuan asked the guards stationed at the city entrance.

"No, but there is one in the city that is just south of here."

"Thanks."

Yuan immediately went to that city and entered the Myriad of Techniques there.

However, he didn’t go there so he could speak with Senior Bai. Rather, he just wanted directions to the Gates of Heaven.

"Where is the Gates of Heaven located?" Yuan asked the man behind the counter.

"Gates of Heaven? You can just teleport there from any major teleportation device," said the man. "If you want to go there on your own... that would be a little difficult, as the sect exists outside the Ninth Heaven."

"I see... thanks."

Shortly after, Yuan left the store and headed to the teleportation device.

Fortunately for him, one was in the same city, so he didn’t have to travel far.

However, as the teleportation device came into view, a figure descended from the sky and landed right in front of him.

Yuan raised an eyebrow after seeing this individual.

"Xiao?" The individual, a beautiful young lady, muttered, staring directly at Yuan’s face.

"..."

Yuan wasn’t sure how to respond.

The individual before him was none other than Qiang Qing Yun, one of the four Celestial Overlords and the one who’d recruited Yuan to join their faction after Xu Jiaqi removed him.

"There’s no point pretending you don’t know me, Xiao. As a Celestial Overlord, I have the authority to see the location of every member of the faction as long as they’re within the Nine Heavens," Qiang Qing Yun continued a moment later, before Yuan could respond.

"I wasn’t going to pretend to not know you," Yuan replied. "I was just surprised by your sudden appearance and wondering why you appeared before me in such a fashion."

"I’ll tell you in a bit. Follow me," she said, turning around and walking away, not giving him the chance to refuse.

Yuan said nothing and quietly followed her.

Qiang Qing Yun led Yuan to an empty alley, then opened a portal.

"Come," she said, then disappeared into the portal.

After following her through the portal, Yuan found himself in a familiar place.

He had been brought to the Celestial Overlords’ Headquarters, a place he had visited once before when Xu Jiaqi took him there.

Although the location was different from the last time he had visited, the atmosphere felt exactly the same.

Some time later, Qiang Qing Yun led Yuan into a building—her private office.

Once inside, she turned around and faced him with a serious expression.

"I’ll get straight to the point. You were the one who clashed with the Second Squad of Heaven’s Mandate—the one responsible for our karma suddenly plummeting, correct?"

’So this is what it’s about...’ Yuan sighed inwardly, realizing his situation.

"How did you come to that conclusion?" Yuan asked.

Qiang Qing Yun rubbed her eyes and sighed before replying, "We have something called the Karma Obelisk, which allows us to track everyone’s karma. Although not everyone has been verified yet... you’re the most suspicious of them."

"I see..." Yuan mumbled.

"Why did you do it?" Qiang Qing Yun asked, a frown slowly forming on her face.

"Who are you, really?"

"Would you believe me if I said it was self-defense?" Yuan said.

"No," she answered immediately.

"You know, there’s a certain rumor going around—that someone forcibly opened the Primordial Realm and allowed several extremely dangerous exiles to escape, and that the Second Squad of Heaven’s Mandate was deployed for that reason."

Although the Celestial Emperor tried to keep the opening of the Primordial Realm and the Asura Clan’s escape a secret to prevent widespread panic, it was inevitable that some of the information would eventually leak out.

Suddenly, Qiang Qing Yun raised her arm, and a sword materialized in her grasp out of thin air before she pointed it directly at Yuan.

"Give me one reason why I shouldn’t cut you down right here and now," she said coldly, her aura steadily rising.
